fields.schemeName: IELTS & TOEFL Training Assistance
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to help tribal students pursue higher studies abroad by offering professional IELTS/TOEFL training. It provides ₹3,10,000/- in training assistance and comprehensive guidance.

fields.schemeName: Pradhan Mantri Surakshit Matritva Abhiyan
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide fixed-day assured, comprehensive and quality antenatal care universally to all pregnant women in 2nd and 3rd trimester on the 9th of every month. It offers free comprehensive antenatal care services at government health facilities.

fields.schemeName: Nagaland State Merit Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: The Directorate of Higher Education has launched the Nagaland State Merit Scholarship for the students of classes from 11th to 12th and UG Degree to PG degree so that they will be able to secure their scholarship rights or seats after getting online registration under this scholarship.

fields.schemeName: Indo-French Visiting/Mobility Programme for Women in Science
fields.briefDescription: This programme will encourage women candidates to work with the Indian/French scientific communities with an aim to accelerate their talented instincts towards carrying out advanced studies and research in the frontier areas of Science & Technology.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry of Women and Child Development
fields.schemeName: Nari Shakti Puraskar - National Award for Women
fields.briefDescription: The award aims to acknowledge the achievements of women & recognize their contributions to society and the nation. The award is conferred annually on individuals in recognition of their exceptional service towards the cause of women’s empowerment, particularly for vulnerable and marginalized women.

fields.schemeName: Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Coffee Development Programme in North Eastern Region: Water Augmentation" aims to improve the productivity and quality of coffee by facilitating the creation of infrastructure for water augmentation for irrigation and wet processing of coffee.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: ICAR - Post Matric Scholarship for Scheduled Caste / Scheduled Tribes Candidates
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide Post-Matric Scholarship to Scheduled Castes/ Scheduled Tribes candidates for study at Bachelor Degree programme in various branches of Agriculture, viz. B.Sc. (Agri.), B.V.Sc., B.Sc. (Agril. Engg.), B.Sc. (Home Science), B.F.Sc., B.Sc. (Forestry) etc.

fields.schemeName: RMEWF-Financial Assistance For Vocational Training Of Widows Of ESM
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to widows of ex-servicemen to help them become self-reliant through vocational training.

fields.schemeName: The Inland Waterways Authority of India Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The purpose of this scheme is to provide with Selected Candidates” short term exposure to different verticals/ divisions/ units of IWAI as “Interns”. An intern may be required to work at Head Office or Project Office depending upon the requirement of the Authority.

fields.schemeName: Travel Grant Scheme for College Teachers/Vice Chancellors/Commission Members
fields.briefDescription: This scheme is for providing financial assistance to permanent teachers of colleges & vice-chancellors of state universities, deemed to be universities & central universities, recognised under section 2(f) and 12 (B) of the UGC Act, to present research papers at international conferences abroad.

fields.schemeName: Production Linked Incentive (PLI) Scheme (PLI 1.2) for Specialty Steel
fields.briefDescription: under this scheme to promote domestic manufacturing of specialty steel by encouraging incremental investment, increasing production of value-added steel, enhancing technological capabilities, and reducing import dependence while generating employment.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Poultry Development
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers loans to farmers for poultry development and cattle development, with funding of up to ₹14,800/- for 200 birds or ₹17,000/- for 2 cows, with an interest rate of 14.5% to 16.5%.

fields.schemeName: Primary Cooperative Agriculture and Rural Development Bank: For Plantation (Tea)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme offers financial assistance of up to ₹33,000/- per acre to farmers for tea plantations, with an interest rate of 11%-12.5%.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom: Export Oriented Production:Large Cardamom Replanting/New planting (Ha)
fields.briefDescription: Under this scheme, growers are encouraged to adopt systematic replanting of large cardamom using high-yielding, disease-free planting materials. It aims to increase productivity, improve quality, and enhance export competitiveness under the Spices Board of India.

fields.schemeName: National Savings Recurring Deposit Account(RD)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the National Savings Recurring Deposit (RD) scheme is to encourage people to save small amounts regularly every month and build savings with safe returns at 6.7% per annum.

fields.schemeName: Post Office Savings Account(SB)
fields.briefDescription: The objective of the Post Office Savings Account (SB) scheme is to encourage people to save money safely with the government. It offers easy access, a low minimum balance of ₹500, and steady interest, helping individuals build regular saving habits.

fields.schemeName: Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Meghalaya Agriculture Response Vehicle Scheme” was launched by the Department of Agriculture & Farmers’ Welfare, Government of Meghalaya to provide Small Commercial Vehicles and pickups at each CD Block across Meghalaya with 50% financial aid from the Government of Meghalaya.

fields.schemeName: Widow Re-marriage Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the rehabilitation of widows by encouraging marriage through a monetary incentive. It provides a grant to bona fide Himachali men (above 21 years) and women (above 18 years) at the time of marriage.

fields.schemeName: Pre-Matric Scholarship For Scheduled Tribe Students Studying In Classes 9th & 10th
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support Scheduled Tribe children in classes 9th and 10th to minimize drop-out rates and aid progression to higher education. The scheme provides a recurring monthly scholarship, an annual book grant, and disability allowances directly to the Scheduled Tribe student beneficiaries.

fields.schemeName: Nikshay Poshan Yojana
fields.briefDescription: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, Government of India has announced the scheme for incentives for nutritional support to TB patients. This scheme will be called “Nikshay Poshan Yojana”.

fields.schemeName: Mizoram Sports Incentive Cash Award Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to provide lump sum cash awards and recognition to outstanding sports persons winning medals in national and international competitions.

fields.schemeName: Award Of Scholarships To Young Artists In Different Cultural Fields
fields.briefDescription: This Scheme seeks to give assistance to young artistes of outstanding promise for advanced training within India in the field of Indian Classical Music, Indian Classical Dance, Theatre, Mime, Visual art, Folk, Traditional and Indigenous Arts and Light Classical Music.

fields.schemeName: AICTE – Saksham Scholarship Scheme For Specially-Abled Student (Degree)
fields.briefDescription: Saksham is a Scholarship Scheme by the Ministry of Education, implemented by AICTE, aimed at providing encouragement and support to specially-abled children to pursue technical education. This is an attempt to give every young specially-abled student the opportunity to study further.

fields.schemeName: ICRO Amrit Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The IPL Centre for Rural Outreach (ICRO) has launched ICRO Amrit Internship Programme focused on youth productivity for prosperity. The interns will be placed at the headquarters and Regional Offices of NPC/ IPL. The duration of the internship will be 3 months initially, renewable up to four times.

fields.schemeName: Integrated Scheme for Export Promotion & Quality Improvement in Spices and Research and Development of Cardamom:Large cardamom Irrigation Land Development : Irrigation / water storage structures(nos)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to motivate the growers to bring more area under irrigation by constructing water storage structures, rain water harvesting structures and installation of irrigation equipments for increasing the productivity and improving quality of large cardamom.

fields.schemeName: Begum Hazrat Mahal National Scholarship Program
fields.briefDescription: Begum Hazrat Mahal National scholarship is a scholarship scheme also known as Maulana Azad National scholarship scheme was first announced on 3rd May 2003. It is a national level scholarship started for the benefit of the girl’s student belonging to the minority communities.

fields.schemeName: Financial Incentive For Inter-Caste Marriages Under Protection Of Civil Rights Act 1955 And Scheduled Castes And Scheduled Tribes (Prevention Of Atrocities) Act 1989 In Assam
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage inter-caste marriages in Assam. It provides a one-time financial assistance of ₹2,50,000/- in a joint fixed deposit for eligible couples where one spouse belongs to a Scheduled Caste and the other to a General Caste Hindu.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Social Justice and Empowerment
fields.schemeName: National Overseas Scholarship For Scheduled Caste Etc. Candidates
fields.briefDescription: A scholarship scheme by MoSJE for regular, full-time students from Scheduled Castes, Denotified Nomadic and Semi Nomadic Tribes, Landless Agricultural Labourers and Traditional Artisans; to obtain higher education viz., Master degree or Ph.D courses by studying abroad

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Personnel, Public Grievances And Pensions
fields.schemeName: Domestic Funding Of Foreign Training
fields.briefDescription: The scheme "Domestic Funding of Foreign Training (DFFT)" is a scheme introduced by the Department of Personnel and Training, Government of India in the year 2001-02 with an objective to upgrade the knowledge & skills of Government officers.

fields.schemeName: Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research
fields.briefDescription: The scheme “Women Involvement in Science and Engineering Research (WISER)” aims to build scientific capacity, retain and promote women researchers in India & Germany by utilizing complementary expertise in science, technology, innovation and research partnerships.

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Skill Development And Entrepreneurship
fields.schemeName: Craftsmen Training Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to ensure steady flow of skilled workers in different trades for domestic industry and reduce unemployment among educated youth. It provides systematic vocational training through Industrial Training Institutes and National Skill Training Institutes across India.

fields.schemeName: Internship Scheme Of The Department Of Economic Affairs
fields.briefDescription: The Internship Scheme aims to familiarise students with macro-economic policy formulation and economic research. Through this scheme, internship opportunities with token remuneration are provided to eligible Post Graduate and PhD students.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Establishment Of Small Scale Dairy Unit (SSDU)
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to support the establishment of dairy units with 10 Gir cows. Through this scheme, capital subsidy and back-ended subsidy are provided to beneficiaries via bank finance and NABARD.

fields.schemeName: Mass Communication Internship Programme
fields.briefDescription: The Mass Communication Internship Programme by the Department of Water Resources, River Development, and Ganga Rejuvenation. The intern program will offer work culture and environment knowledge about the functioning of the Government and its departments in information, education, and communication.

fields.schemeName: Promotion of Exportable surplus of identified spices in NE: Cultivation of Lakadong turmeric (Ha)
fields.briefDescription: To promote the cultivation of Lakadong turmeric for exports by providing 50% of the cost of planting material, subject to a maximum of ₹ 30,000 per Ha, to turmeric growers of the North East having land holding size of 0.10 Ha to 8 Ha.

fields.schemeName: Nyaya Mitra Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to facilitate the expeditious disposal of ten to fifteen years old pending court cases. It provides legal advice, case assistance, and Lok Adalat referrals to marginalized litigants by engaging retired officers.

fields.schemeName: Prime Minister’s Scholarship Scheme for the Wards of Central Armed Police Forces & Assam Rifles
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage higher technical and professional education for dependent wards and widows of CAPFs/Assam Rifles personnel martyred during Terror/Naxal attacks. Through this scheme, Financial support per year for girls and boys is provided.

fields.schemeName: Vice Chancellor Internship Scheme
fields.briefDescription: The Vice Chancellor Internship Scheme (VCIS) by the University of Delhi aims to provide students with experiential learning opportunities, integrating academic knowledge with practical work experience. This initiative aligns with the objectives of "Samagra Shiksha" (holistic education) as outlined..

fields.nodalMinistryName: Ministry Of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
fields.schemeName: Agri-Clinics And Agri-Business Centres Scheme
fields.briefDescription: A welfare scheme by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare was launched in 2002. AC&ABC aims at agricultural development, supplementing the efforts of public extension by providing extension and other services to farmers either on a payment basis or free of cost as per the business model.

fields.schemeName: Virasat Loan Scheme of NMDFC
fields.briefDescription: Concessional credit of up to ₹10,00,000/- can be availed under Credit Line-1 & 2.  to meet Working Capital  and Fixed Capital for purchase of equipment/tools/machineries/raw material by the Minority Artisan.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Construction and Redevelopment Incentives
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to encourage affordable rental housing development. Through this scheme, Floor Space Index benefits and regulatory relaxations are provided to eligible housing projects.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Scheme for Promotion of Affordable Rental Smart Housing (SPARSH 2.0): Rent Subsidy
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to reduce the rental burden on workers and economically weaker section families residing in affordable rental housing complexes.

fields.schemeName: Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship
fields.briefDescription: "Swami Vivekananda Merit-cum-Means Scholarship" started by the Higher Education Department of West Bengal State for the financial assistance to the student.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Supply of School Uniform , Shoes Socks to all Students for Std IX to XII
fields.briefDescription: Supply of School Uniform, Shoes Socks to all Students for IX to XII studying in Govt Schools

fields.schemeName: Summer Internship Programme (PRL)
fields.briefDescription: The Physical Research Laboratory (PRL) Summer Internship Programme aims to provide a platform for highly motivated students & teachers to interact with PRL’s scientists, gaining exposure to the lab’s research areas and facilities. Participants will work on projects in fundamental science, technology

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Scholarships for Top Class Education for students with Disabilities, DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: Scholarship for Students with Disabilities, DNH & DD offers tuition fee reimbursement up to ₹1.9 lakh, maintenance allowance, book grant, laptop support, assistive devices, and special disability allowances for eligible UG/PG students in notified institutes. Income limit: ₹8 lakh p.a.

fields.schemeName: Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers
fields.briefDescription: The "Financial Assistance for Marriage for the Construction Workers" by the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board, Labour Department, Delhi, is a welfare scheme  that provides financial assistance for marriage of self and for upto 2 children.

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeShortTitle: SS-DADRA AND NAGAR HAVELI AND DAMAN & DIU
fields.schemeName: Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0, DNH & DD
fields.briefDescription: The Union Territory of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu has successfully launched the "Mission Saksham Anganwadi & Poshan 2.0" scheme to provide nutritional support for children below 6 years of age, Pregnant Women and Lactating Mothers (PW&LM), and Adolescent Girls (14-18 years).

beneficiaryState: Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu
fields.schemeName: Scheme for Loan and Subsidy for Manure and Fertilizer-DNH&DD
fields.briefDescription: The scheme aims to promote fertiliser use for higher productivity. Subsidy-cum-loan assistance is provided in kind to small and marginal farmers.

fields.schemeName: INAE Travel Grant Scheme for Engineering Students from IITs/NITs/Govt. Approved Engineering Colleges/Institutions other than AICTE
fields.briefDescription: A Travel Grant Scheme by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) and by the Indian National Academy of Engineering (INAE), for the students from AICTE approved Engineering College/institutions. The scheme aims at enhancing the quality of engineering education in the country.
